payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over k possible starting offsets modulo k, compute sum of every k-th element, and choose the offset with minimum sum.
payload.rationale: The solution performs an exhaustive search over k starting positions, which correspond to cyclic shifts, akin to enumerating permutations of the starting point. No backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, or graph traversal is used.
